# FrameLab App Store Screenshot Generator

> FrameLab is a browser-based editor for creating professional App Store and Google Play screenshots. It runs entirely client-side with multi-device layouts, templates, status bars, rich text, overlays, and batch export.

GitHub: https://github.com/awade12/framelab
Maintainer: Andrew Wade (awade75009@gmail.com)
License: Proprietary — All Rights Reserved

## What FrameLab Does

FrameLab lets mobile developers and marketers design polished app store screenshots in the browser. Users pick device frames, upload app screenshots, style backgrounds and text, and export pixel-perfect PNGs at required store resolutions. No server uploads, no accounts, no watermarks.

## Look & Feel

- Dark charcoal editor (`#0a0a0a`) with zinc-muted controls and white preview cards
- Three-panel layout: collapsible left toolbar, center screenshot carousel, right inspector
- Real-time preview with drag-and-drop for text, devices, and overlays
- Quick actions in the left sidebar: templates, undo/redo, duplicate, apply style to all
- Modals for fonts, templates, export progress, and post-export GitHub support

## Core Features

### Device Frames
- 6 mockups: iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 14, iPad Pro 12.9", Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra, Samsung Galaxy Tab S9
- Multiple colors per device
- Multi-device layouts with independent screen images and transforms
- Cross-screen device overflow between adjacent screenshots
- Flat 2D and 3D rendering with rotation controls
- Frameless mode and in-screen zoom/pan
- Status bar overlay with time, battery, signal, Wi‑Fi, and light/dark style

### Backgrounds & Text
- 60+ solid color presets, custom picker, and 6 gradient presets
- Rich text editor with bold, italic, underline, color, alignment, and rounded highlights
- Google Fonts catalog with categories, search, and lazy loading
- Drag-to-reposition headlines and subheadlines

### Overlays & Layout
- Unlimited overlay images with resize, rotation, layer order, and shadows
- 8 layout presets and manual device positioning controls

### Workflow
- Starter templates for common App Store sets
- Multiple projects with localStorage auto-save
- Undo/redo, duplicate screen, apply style to all

### Export
- Batch export as ZIP or single PNG
- App Store iPhone sizes (6.9", 6.7", landscape) at exact Apple dimensions
- iPad and Play Store phone sizes
- Quality tiers for non-App Store exports: Standard, High (2×), Ultra (3×)
- Export progress modal and pixel-perfect canvas rendering

## Tech Stack

- React 19, TanStack Router, Tailwind CSS 4, Vite 7, Vitest, Bun
- JSZip for batch export, Canvas API for rendering

## Running Locally

```
git clone https://github.com/awade12/framelab.git
cd framelab
bun install
bun run dev
```

Available at http://localhost:5173
